description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements a logging node that wraps Android's native Log utility to forward logs. It supports chaining to other LogNodes for further processing.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps the Android native Log utility to output log messages and support chaining to other LogNodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable, then forwards the log to the next node if available.
